label: HISTORICAL REPLAY SCORING — not shadow, not live, not submitted, not filled, not settled, not realized
corpus_coverage_caveat: The canonical sequence holds 22 active days: 2026-03-19..04-21 and 2026-08-28..31. Regimes R2/R3 of canon_regimes.json and era E2_EARLY_REBATE have ZERO rows here — a gap in OUR collection, not in L5's activity. No regime is invented.

protocol.split: chronological by window start, no window overlap
protocol.tuning: none — every bucket, feature set and alpha is taken from the frozen production modules

unscorable_fields.price_offset_ticks_vs_touch: No contemporaneous order book exists for L5's windows, so the offset in ticks from the same-side best bid is not computable for any row (analysis/l5/L5_TOUCH_PROXIMITY.md §0). The deployed model also emits no touch-relative price. MISSING ARTIFACT: a per-second L2 top-of-book time series covering L5's traded windows. The only book we hold is Zenodo 22084977 (2026-08-21..24 BTC15m, analysis/l5/historical_l2/), whose overlap with the canonical sequence is ZERO windows, and whose own measurement found 26.4% of L5 maker fills at or above the prevailing ask — i.e. not placeable as a touch offset at all.
unscorable_fields.withdraw: No order-lifecycle data. The corpus is a FILL tape; resting, cancelled and repriced L5 orders are unobservable, so a WITHDRAW is indistinguishable from a WAIT. MISSING ARTIFACT: L5 order placement/cancel events, which the venue does not serve.
unscorable_fields.wait: Not a row in the fill-transition space. Scored separately on an opportunity grid in analysis/l5/act_wait/ (Stage 1); cited, not re-scored, here.

side_errors.note: Per-share settlement P&L of the legs the model mislabels, versus the legs it labels correctly. A clone that takes the model's side instead of L5's on the wrong rows buys the complement at (1 - the pair's other price), so the sign of this difference is the directional cost of the side error.

size_errors.note: Bucket midpoints (2.5 / 10 / 27.5 / 70 shares) are a stated convention, not a measurement; the ratio is indicative of scale error, not an exact dollar figure.

relation_confusion_economics.note: Each extend-called-complete row is a clone that flattens inventory L5 kept building, and each complete-called-extend row is a clone that doubles down where L5 reduced. The settlement P&L shown is L5's own on those legs.
